comments.snippet:
Outcome: not a defect.

This report is from 1.84.0 (Release 3716), portable x64. Closing a tab raised FileLoadException while loading Interop.MSTSCLib.dll. HRESULT 0x800711C7, and the message says an Application Control policy blocked the file. The report says the app continued.

Current main still ships that COM library beside the program (EmbedInteropTypes is false). Nothing since v1.84.0 embeds or moves it, so a newer build does not remove the block. We did not reproduce the dialog on our...
